cases.task: Choose the safe pagination rule when a filtered event page is full and the bounded scan has not proven end of log.

required_facts.text: A filtered page returned its limit of matching events. Later matching events may be separated by more than one storage batch of non-matching events.
The API must never skip a matching event and each continuation must remain bounded.

optional_facts.text: An empty later page is acceptable when it proves the bounded scan reached the end of the log.
